verify.breaking_change: The change breaks existing callers, public APIs, stored data, configuration or CLI behavior.
verify.security_relevant: The input touches authentication, authorization, secrets, cryptography, input validation, injection surfaces, or exposure of sensitive data.
verify.secret_leak: The input contains a real-looking credential, API key, private key or token.
verify.needs_tests: The change alters behavior in a way existing tests are unlikely to cover.
verify.migration_required: Deploying the change safely requires a database, data or configuration migration.
verify.rollback_safe: The change can be rolled back by redeploying the previous version, without data repair or manual cleanup.
verify.perf_sensitive: The change touches a hot path, query, large loop, cache or resource limit in a way that can affect latency or cost.
verify.needs_clarification: The request is too ambiguous to implement without asking its author.
verify.is_flaky: The failure is likely nondeterministic (timing, ordering, network, shared state, randomness) rather than a deterministic bug.
verify.production_impact: The problem affects production users, not only development or test environments.
verify.ai_behavior_change: The change can alter what a model or agent outputs: prompts, model choice, sampling parameters, retrieval, tools, guardrails, or training data.
verify.needs_evals: Whether the change is correct can only be confirmed by evaluating model or agent outputs, not by unit tests alone.
verify.prompt_injection_exposure: Untrusted content (user input, web pages, documents, emails, tool results, retrieved chunks) reaches a model that can call tools or influence actions.
verify.excessive_agency: An agent gets tools or permissions beyond what its task needs, or can take consequential actions without human approval.
verify.unvalidated_model_output: Code acts on model output (executes it, queries with it, sends it, or calls tools with it) without validating it against a schema, type or allowlist.
verify.model_unpinned: The code depends on a floating model alias (such as latest) or an unpinned checkpoint or dataset version.
verify.pii_in_ai_data: Personal or sensitive data can flow into prompts, logs, embeddings, training data, or third-party model APIs.
verify.ml_data_leakage: Training, validation and test data overlap, or features or preprocessing use information that is not available at prediction time.
verify.nondeterministic: Outputs vary between runs (sampling temperature, unseeded randomness, nondeterministic GPU ops, provider model updates) in a way tests must account for.
